entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back for a pair of spin class shoes.
Certainly, I can help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I bought these cycling shoes, and I'd like to return them.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now. I see the purchase of the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered on September 16th, 2025. Is that correct?
That sounds right. It was about two and a half months ago.
Alright. And what seems to be the issue with the shoes? Are you having a problem with the fit or a technical fault?
It's the fit. I've tried to break them in, but they just keep giving me blisters. I even tried adjusting the cleats, but they're just not working for me. I'd like to get a refund if possible.
I understand completely. Getting blisters is no fun. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since the item was delivered within the last 90 days, you are fully eligible for a return.
That's great news. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund.

Okay, I appreciate that. Now, since I had to go through the trouble of trying them, getting blisters, and now shipping them back, would it be possible to also get a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 15% off?

I understand your position, but our policy for a standard return is to provide a full refund for the item, which covers the cost of your purchase. The pre-paid label also covers your shipping, so there's no cost to you. We aren't able to offer additional discounts on top of a full refund.
I see. Not even a 10% code for the inconvenience? I'm still a VeloFit customer and plan to buy other gear.

I'm sorry, but my system doesn't allow for that in this situation. The approved resolution is the full refund. I have processed the return label for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's alright. A full refund is fair enough. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Have a great day, and we hope your next VeloFit product is a perfect fit!
